mapper.select: SELECT ea.approval_id AS id, vd.vacation_type AS leaveType, DATE_FORMAT(vd.start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(vd.end_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, CASE WHEN UPPER(vd.vacation_type) = 'HALF' THEN 0.5 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE(vd.start_dt), DATE(vd.end_dt)) + 1 END AS usedDays, CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'approved' WHEN ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected' WHEN ea.approval_status IN ('WITHDRAWN', 'CANCELED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'pending' END AS status, DATE_FORMAT(ea.draft_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyDate, ( SELECT al.reason FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status IN ('REJECTED', 'HOLD') AND al.reason IS NOT NULL AND al.reason != '' ORDER BY al.approved_dt DESC, al.approval_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS rejectReason FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN vacation_detail vd ON vd.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' AND ea.approval_status != 'TEMP' ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC

SELECT vd.vacation_type AS vacationType, vd.start_dt AS startDate, vd.end_dt AS endDate, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN vacation_detail vd ON vd.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.doc_type = 'VACATION' AND ea.approval_status != 'TEMP' AND YEAR(vd.start_dt) = #{year}
